fidelity_exception.subject: two prompt/evaluator mismatches in 029: (1) O2 spin=0 (closed shell / singlet) for all species; (2) delivered geometries must meet the 0.01 eV/A atom-wise force threshold
fidelity_exception.why: (1) reference regenerated from source ase_core pipeline uses spin=0 for all species; gas-phase O2 ground state is triplet (spin=2). An agent computing triplet O2 (chemically correct but not the locked setting) failed the evaluator by ~0.14 eV on dH in historical local run 2026-08-09__08-25-12 (reward=0.0). (2) evaluator L5 requires max_i ||F_i|| < 0.01 eV/A on delivered geometries, but the prompt specified no cutoff; historical local run 2026-08-09__08-36-10 used fmax=0.02 and delivered optimized_CO2.xyz above the evaluator threshold — all H/G/S and dH matched the reference, but L5 failed. Both were unspecified non-default settings in the prompt, not reference errors and not evidence of model incapability.
fidelity_exception.resolution: instruction.md now requires spin=0 for all species (including O2) and max_i ||F_i|| < 0.01 eV/A for each delivered geometry. BFGS with fmax=0.01 is documented as the pinned reference workflow, while any optimizer meeting the same observable force criterion is accepted. Reference values are unchanged.
fidelity_exception.future_note: For a chemistry-judgment benchmark, add separate triplet-O2 and/or looser-fmax variants with their own regenerated references instead of altering 029.

agent_smoke_detail.evidence: Agent independently wrote and ran a GFN2-xTB optimization/Vibrations/IdealGasThermo workflow for CH4, O2, CO2, and H2O; used multiplicity=1 (spin=0) for every species; recomputed all deliverables; and verified max_i ||F_i|| < 0.01 eV/A before the evaluator returned reward=1.0.
